name: Klaus
source: A childhood friend of Tiana. She considers him a big brother, who since she was little scolded her and took care of her since her parents dissapeared. Klaus graduated with honors from the Royal Academy of Zarudine, and became the vice-director of the Cattleya Royal Library. He and Matheus were classmates at school, and they thought of each other as rivals.
